review: triage 701.58b/c/d: reclassified decision -> legality (playability, direct); each states which face-up procedures are permitted, an engine verdict, as in the verified 701.40 sibling; added 701.58b-1 (Grizzly Bears vs Shock), 701.58c-1 (Exalted Angel vs Serra Angel), 701.58d-1 (Bolrac-Clan Basher vs Craw Wurm).

scenarios.title: A cloaked card enters the battlefield face down as a nameless 2/2 creature with ward {2}

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A activates Ransom Note, paying {2} by tapping both Islands and sacrificing Ransom Note, choosing the mode 'Cloak the top card of your library'.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: creature_card
variants.expected: Ransom Note is in A's graveyard. Serra Angel enters A's battlefield face down: a 2/2 colorless creature with no name, no subtypes, no mana cost and ward {2}; it has no flying or vigilance. A's library is Forest, Forest.

variants.label: noncreature_card
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is Lightning Bolt instead of Serra Angel.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt enters A's battlefield face down as a 2/2 colorless creature with no name, no subtypes, no mana cost and ward {2}; it is a creature, not an instant.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: Ransom Note is sacrificed and its ability resolves, but there is no card to cloak: A controls no face-down creature.

scenarios.forge_notes: The cloaked permanent gets ward {2} from the cloak effect (Forge adds Ward:2 to the face-down state).

scenarios.title: A cloaked creature has ward {2}, so a spell targeting it is countered unless its controller pays {2}

setup.notes: A's face-down Serra Angel is a cloaked permanent (a 2/2 creature with ward {2}).

decisions: B casts Shock targeting A's face-down creature, tapping Mountain.
Ward's triggered ability goes on the stack above Shock; both players pass and it resolves.
If B has mana to pay {2}, B pays it.

variants.label: cannot_pay
variants.expected: Ward triggers and B has no untapped mana to pay {2}, so Shock is countered: A's face-down creature has no damage and stays on the battlefield; Shock is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: pays_ward
variants.delta: B controls two additional Mountains and pays {2} with them.
variants.expected: Ward triggers but B pays {2}, so Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to the 2/2 face-down creature; it dies and is put into A's graveyard face up as Serra Angel.

scenarios.forge_notes: A pre-built cloaked permanent may not carry the Ward:2 that cloaking normally adds; reach the state by cloaking the card during the scenario if Forge's setup loses it.

scenarios.title: A cloaked permanent can be turned face up for its mana cost only if its card is a creature card

setup.notes: The face-down permanent is a cloaked permanent (a 2/2 creature with ward {2}); its card is named in each variant.

decisions: A holds priority in main phase 1 and tries to turn the cloaked permanent face up by revealing its card and paying its mana cost with Mountain and Forest.

variants.label: creature_card
variants.expected: Turning the permanent face up is legal. A pays {1}{G}; the permanent is turned face up and is Grizzly Bears, a green 2/2 Bear with no ward.

variants.label: instant_card
variants.delta: The cloaked card is Shock instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Turning the permanent face up for its mana cost is not legal although Mountain could pay {R}. It stays a face-down colorless 2/2 creature with ward {2} and no name.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge offers turning a cloaked card face up as an ability of the face-down card, so the verdict appears as that candidate's can_play.

scenarios.title: A cloaked card with morph can be turned face up for its morph cost

setup.notes: The face-down permanent is a cloaked permanent; its card is named in each variant. A has exactly four Plains, so neither {4}{W}{W} nor {3}{W}{W} can be paid.

decisions: A holds priority in main phase 1 and tries to turn the cloaked permanent face up, paying {2}{W}{W} with the four Plains.

variants.label: morph_card
variants.expected: Turning the permanent face up for its morph cost {2}{W}{W} is legal. A taps the four Plains and the permanent is Exalted Angel, a white 4/5 with flying.

variants.label: no_morph
variants.delta: The cloaked card is Serra Angel (mana cost {3}{W}{W}, no morph) instead of Exalted Angel.
variants.expected: No way to turn the permanent face up is legal: Serra Angel has no morph cost and A's four Plains cannot pay {3}{W}{W}. It stays a face-down colorless 2/2 with ward {2}.

scenarios.title: A cloaked card with disguise can be turned face up for its disguise cost

setup.notes: The face-down permanent is a cloaked permanent; its card is named in each variant. A has exactly five Mountains, so a six-mana cost cannot be paid.

decisions: A holds priority in main phase 1 and tries to turn the cloaked permanent face up, paying {3}{R}{R} with the five Mountains.

variants.label: disguise_card
variants.expected: Turning the permanent face up for its disguise cost {3}{R}{R} is legal. A taps the five Mountains and the permanent is Bolrac-Clan Basher, a red 3/2 with double strike and trample and no ward.

variants.label: no_disguise
variants.delta: The cloaked card is Craw Wurm (mana cost {4}{G}{G}, no disguise) instead of Bolrac-Clan Basher.
variants.expected: No way to turn the permanent face up is legal: Craw Wurm has no disguise cost and A's five Mountains cannot pay {4}{G}{G}. It stays a face-down colorless 2/2 with ward {2}.

scenarios.title: Several cards cloaked from one library enter the battlefield face down one at a time

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Hide in Plain Sight, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; it resolves. A looks at the top five cards, chooses Serra Angel and Grizzly Bears to cloak, and the other three go to the bottom in a random order.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.expected: Serra Angel and Grizzly Bears each enter A's battlefield face down as separate 2/2 colorless creatures with no name and ward {2}. A's library is Mountain followed by Forest, Island and Plains in a random order; Hide in Plain Sight is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: one_card_library
variants.delta: A's library is only Serra Angel.
variants.expected: Only Serra Angel can be cloaked: one face-down 2/2 creature with ward {2} enters, and A's library is empty.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: Nothing is cloaked: A controls no face-down creature.

scenarios.forge_notes: The one-at-a-time entry is only visible as two separate enter-the-battlefield events.

scenarios.title: A card that would be cloaked but cannot enter the battlefield stays in its zone unmodified

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A activates Ransom Note, paying {2} by tapping both Islands and sacrificing Ransom Note, choosing the mode 'Cloak the top card of your library'.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: cage_on_battlefield
variants.expected: Ransom Note is in A's graveyard. Grafdigger's Cage stops the face-down creature from entering the battlefield, so Serra Angel is not cloaked: it stays on top of A's library, face up with its normal characteristics. A controls no face-down creature.

variants.label: cage_in_hand
variants.delta: Grafdigger's Cage is in B's hand instead of on B's battlefield.
variants.expected: Nothing prohibits the entry: Serra Angel enters A's battlefield face down as a 2/2 colorless creature with ward {2}. A's library is Forest, Forest.

scenarios.forge_notes: Grafdigger's Cage is a Moved replacement keyed on the entering object being a creature; cloaking turns the card face down before it moves, so Forge should see a creature. In the cage_in_hand variant put Grafdigger's Cage in B's hand.

scenarios.title: A cloaked instant or sorcery that would turn face up stays face down and turned-face-up triggers do not fire

setup.notes: A's face-down Lightning Bolt is a cloaked permanent (a 2/2 creature with ward {2}). Aven Farseer is a 1/1 flier.

decisions: A casts Expose the Culprit choosing only the mode 'Turn target face-down creature face up', targeting the face-down Lightning Bolt, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Expose the Culprit resolves.

variants.label: instant_card
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is revealed but is an instant card, so it stays face down as a 2/2 creature. Aven Farseer's turned-face-up trigger does not fire: Aven Farseer is still 1/1 with no counter.

variants.label: creature_card
variants.delta: The cloaked card is Serra Angel instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Serra Angel turns face up and is a 4/4 flying, vigilance Serra Angel again. Aven Farseer's trigger fires and Aven Farseer gets a +1/+1 counter (2/2).
